title: Validation errors return 422 where the spec suggests 400
evidence: src/lib.rs:50 ApiError::Validation maps to StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says '(400)'. Malformed JSON does return 400 (src/lib.rs:48).
suggestion: 422 is defensible for semantic validation, but return 400 if strict spec conformance to the stated code is desired.
